column2: Riding the borders with a patrol, [court_hero.GetTitledFirstName] was cornered in a ravine by a dozen raiders, beastmen by some accounts, bandits by others. [court_hero.GetSheHeCap] cut down half of them and the rest fled into the trees. The court can talk of nothing else, and the minstrels have already added a few more raiders to the tale.
We shall honour [court_hero.GetHerHim]!
A Sword of Battle for a fine warrior.
I could have done just as well.

A patrol riding the borders was ambushed on the forest road. [court_coward.GetTitledFirstName] wheeled [court_coward.GetHerHis] horse about and fled, leaving [court_coward.GetHerHis] men to die. Only two came home, and they have been telling everyone who will listen.
That was ill done.
Throw [court_coward.GetHerHim] in the dungeon!
Banish [court_coward.GetHerHim] for cowardice!
Back out there, and do not come back without a head.
[court_coward.GetFirstName] rides out again. [court_coward.GetSheHeCap] may win back [court_coward.GetHerHis] name, fail again, or not return at all.\n

The example of [heroknight_pupil.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName] has worked wonders on [heroknight_pupil.GetFirstName]. Your [heroknight_pupil.GetSonDaughter] climbed the tallest tower of the keep on a dare, faced down a stable hound twice [heroknight_pupil.GetHerHis] size, and now insists on riding at the head of every hunt.
Excellent!
[heroknight_pupil.GetSheHeCap] should be careful...

Hour after hour in the practice yard with [heroknight_pupil.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName], with horse, lance and blade, has turned your [heroknight_pupil.GetSonDaughter] [heroknight_pupil.GetFirstName] into a sturdy young [heroknight_pupil.GetManWoman] who rarely falls ill and never tires.

Your [heroknight_pupil.GetSonDaughter] [heroknight_pupil.GetFirstName] follows [heroknight_pupil.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName] everywhere with a wooden sword, and has started picking fights with every page and squire at court. [heroknight_pupil.GetSheHeCap] wins most of them.
This could be good, or bad...
That's my boy!
That's my girl!

[heroknight_pupil.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName] has taught your [heroknight_pupil.GetSonDaughter] [heroknight_pupil.GetFirstName] that a strong arm serves the weak, and that the law binds the lord as much as the peasant. Yesterday [heroknight_pupil.GetSheHe] made a guard return a loaf he had taken from a beggar.
[heroknight_pupil.GetSheHeCap] makes me proud!
Such notions are for fools!

My [Root.GetLordLady], your [heroknight_pupil.GetSonDaughter] [heroknight_pupil.GetFirstName] fell hard from [heroknight_pupil.GetHerHis] horse while practising at sword and lance with [heroknight_pupil.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName]. The physicians are with [heroknight_pupil.GetHerHim] now.
I hope [heroknight_pupil.GetSheHe] will come around!
This is a most grievous wound!
